routes.consistency: index generation + embedding model hash + derived_from_epoch
one declared source_epoch plus candidate provenance

planner_rules: exact-address before associative search when key is known
never silently mix canonical rows from different source epochs in cognition-critical reads
if derived_from_epoch < requested source_epoch then mark STALE and either rebuild, canonical-resolve, or downgrade to exploratory
record result_refs, planner, source_epoch, graph/index epoch, admissibility and result hash
approximate vector index must declare recall-affecting mode; ANN rank cannot answer truth queries
provider-side current state outranks stale local mirror for exact external effect verification
cost_policy: prefer prepared bounded assembly; avoid total-memory scan/global graph rebuild on hot path
